title: Laredo Police Open Hiring Nov. 30 as New Five-Year Contract Raises Entry Pay to About $78,000
excerpt: The Laredo Police Department opens applications Nov. 30 for its next officer class, under a new five-year contract that lifts entry-level patrol pay to about $78,000 in January 2027.
content:
The Laredo Police Department is accepting applications from November 30 through December 12, 2026, for its next class of officers, under a new five-year contract with the Laredo Police Officers Association that significantly raises officer pay.

Entry-level patrol pay rises to about $78,000 a year starting in January 2027, up from about $73,500, and to about $82,540 by October 2027. Academy cadets start at $56,992.

With incentives included, the department's recruitment figures put starting pay at $85,500, rising to $89,500 in the second year and $111,000 at 10 years, with a $5,000 incentive for first-year officers. Total compensation can exceed $100,000 a year.

The contract also adds a $1-an-hour weekend differential and a $200-a-month patrol incentive, with higher pay for evening and overnight shifts.

Police Chief Miguel Rodriguez said the agreement will position Laredo among the highest-paying police departments in Texas. The department has said the raises are aimed at recruiting new officers and keeping experienced ones from leaving for state and federal agencies.

Applicants face a pre-agility exam on January 9-10, 2027, followed by a written exam on January 22, 2027. Those interested can apply at JoinLaredoPD.com.

Source: Laredo Police Department.
